title: POSTERIOR & STRETCH
subtitle: WEDNESDAY KIND. SOFT BACK. GENTLE REACH.

script.welcome: Hello Pam. I'm Stratton. Wednesday is soft posterior work and a gentle stretch — a short, kind break from the chair. About eleven minutes. If a joint is sore, take a smaller range. Showing up is the win.
script.start: Whenever you're ready. Easy breath. This is meant to feel doable.
script.nextExercise: Next one. Shake it out if you like. No rush.
script.rest: Have a little rest. Breathe easy.
script.lastSet: Last set. Make it comfortable and clean.
script.complete: That's us. Lovely work. Soft back, a gentle stretch, and you showed up. Enjoy your Wednesday — see you tomorrow.
script.resume: Back with you. Easy as we go.

exercises.name: SEATED ROW
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat. Soft belly. Elbows bent, hands forward as if holding light weights or a band. Draw the elbows back gently and squeeze the shoulder blades together a little, then ease forward with control. Soft neck. A smaller squeeze is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated row to open the upper back. Two sets of eight. Soft belly, draw the elbows back and squeeze the shoulder blades a little, then ease forward. Soft neck. Smaller squeeze is fine.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty five seconds. Soften the upper back. Easy breath.

exercises.name: SIT TO STAND
exercises.cue: Sit near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat under the knees. Soft belly. Lean a little forward and stand tall with control, then sit back gently. Use the chair lightly with your hands if you like. Soft knees. A smaller stand is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Sit to stand for a soft posterior chain. Two sets of six. Soft belly, lean a little forward, stand tall, then sit back gently. Use the chair if you like. Soft knees. Smaller stand is fine.
exercises.speakRest: Thirty seconds. Soften the legs. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: Sit to stand done. Steady work.

exercises.name: SEATED FORWARD REACH
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat. Soft belly. Hinge gently from the hips and reach the hands forward toward the floor or shins only as far as feels kind — a soft good-morning feel. Soft neck. Hold a gentle stretch, then come back up with control. A smaller reach is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated forward reach for a soft hinge and hamstring stretch. Two holds of about twenty seconds. Soft belly, hinge gently from the hips, reach only as far as feels kind. Soft neck. Smaller reach is fine.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Soften the back. Easy breath.

exercises.name: CHAIR BALANCE
exercises.cue: Stand beside a sturdy chair, light hand on the backrest. Softly shift weight onto one foot and lift the other heel or foot just a little. Soft belly, soft standing knee. Hold about twenty seconds, then switch sides. Keep the chair close — more support is always fine.
exercises.speakStart: Chair balance to finish. Two sets of about twenty seconds each side. Light hand on the chair, soft weight on one foot, lift the other heel a little. Soft knee. More support is always fine.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Soften the standing leg. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: Chair balance done. That's the session — lovely work.
